component.name: LGL DNF Helper
component.summary: Inspect RPM packages and DNF5 dependencies

description.p: LGL DNF Helper is a graphical utility for understanding installed RPM packages on Fedora systems using DNF5 and RPM metadata.

Search for a package, command, capability, partial package name, or file path, then inspect what the package requires, what requires it, which files it owns, which config may matter, and where it came from.
The application is read-only and does not run as root. If DNF5 is not installed, it opens in setup mode with installation guidance.

Migrates to GTK 4 for better theming and a better look on GTK desktops. The app now follows the desktop theme live, has a header bar with the app's actions, an optional system title bar (Ctrl+Shift+M), a main menu that opens with Alt, HTML Help with native tables and package badges (F1 or Escape closes it), and Ctrl+F to focus search.

Search always includes partial name matches, config is split into System Config and User Config tabs, and History shows each full command line with the package's version change. Lists build dependencies as Build Requires instead of Requires, shows the dependencies of one build instead of every version and architecture, counts every package that depends on a package in Impact, corrects the leaf package check, and no longer shows "(none)" in package versions found by file path.
Added sortable tables, resizable package result panes, and automatic search-field focus.
Fixed the desktop entry using a hardcoded local absolute path for the application icon instead of the installed icon name.
Bug fix release: resolved repoquery timeouts, corrected Required By tab data, fixed versioned shared library file classification, and minor code quality improvements.
First minor release of the read-only DNF/RPM package inspection workflow.
Improved reset behavior, search result grouping, fuzzy package matching, package descriptions, config discovery, and error reporting.
